profile.headline: Culture | Leadership | Service | Software
profile.summary:
I've enjoyed a wide range of experience across multiple industries, working in both managerial and non-managerial roles. I've fallen in love with the intellectual and technical challenge of software and its power to have an immediate, direct impact on the work and lives of its users. I've had the pleasure to work with Youversion - who recently surpassed 500Million downloads, Percy.ai - where I managed the front-end implementation of real estate focused web applications and Avaneer Health - who is updating the healthcare industry's B2B communication processes an capabilities.

More than anything, I've learned the character of leadership is the #1 contributor to a team's success. While its easy to confuse leadership with authority, there is a significant difference between leading others to effectuate change and leveraging power. True leaders serve those they lead.

Enneagram 5
Print Assessment: Major 5, Minor 9
Strength Finders: Strategic, Intellection, Futuristic, Self-Assurance, Responsibility

positions.description: Skills: Mapbox · JavaScript · Web Development · React.js · Apollo GraphQL · Google Maps API · HTML · GitHub

positions.title: Production and Operations Manager
positions.description:
Weighting Comforts is on a mission to reduce anxiety and sleeplessness by designing and manufacturing high quality products for an anxious and sleepless population. 

Operations Manager
•	Coordinated interdepartmental activities to ensure operational efficiency
•	Managed a production team of 50+ employees from 9 countries speaking 7 languages
•	Modified manufacturing processes to reduce production time by more than 35%
•	Reduced average order turnaround from 3 weeks to 57 hours 
•	Created and managed supply chain systems and manufacturing processes, guiding growth of 600% and 400% in my first two years with the company respectively

positions.title: Outpatient Float Nurse
positions.description:
Assisted in the creation new clinics by; Creating patient and clinic work flow systems, Coordinating efforts between multiple departments, troubleshooting with IT, Training new staff.

Outpatient clinic experience in the following fields:Autonomic Dysfunction, Cardiology, Orthopedic-Spine, Neurosurgery-spine, Franklin Bone and Joint, Ingram Cancer clinic and Hematology Lab, Breast Cancer Center, Neurology (Parkinsons, ALS, Multiple Sclerosis, Movement disorders), Gastroenterology and Urology.

positions.title: Licensed Vocational Nurse
positions.description:
As a NCO, I Provided medical support for military operations in southern Iraq. I functioned as Shift Leader on the intermediate Care Ward and was awarded the Army Commendation Medal.   
Areas of practice while Assigned to the 115th CSH; Med/Surg, Burn care, Preoperative and postoperative services, Psychiatric, trauma and correctional facility health care.
Held shift leader and team leader positions. First line supervisor.

positions.title: LVN/Supervisor
positions.description:
Maintained readiness for rapid deployment to natural disasters. Provided medical coverage for the Fort Polk Joint Readiness Training Center. 
Instructor for Combat Lifesaver Course. 
1st Line supervisor/Team leader.
